summary: Core enforcement logic correctly implemented. 5 FIX findings: /autopilot/stop not refactored to shared function (Phase 0 gap persists), _pause_project_workflows missing 'starting' agent status, log messages still say 'user-paused', missing tests for 2 of 3 guard locations, budget guard uses separate DB session. 2 DEFER: frontend UI deferred per architecture.

fixes.title: /autopilot/stop endpoint NOT refactored to shared _pause_project_workflows()
fixes.description: Architecture FR-4 explicitly required refactoring /autopilot/stop to use the shared _pause_project_workflows() from cost_derivation.py. The endpoint still uses inline logic with definition_id == 'autopilot' filter, missing Phase 0 workflows (definition_id == 'autopilot-phase0'). This is the exact Phase 0 bug the architecture identified.
fixes.recommended_fix: Replace inline pause logic with: _pause_project_workflows(db, project_id, paused_by='user'). Keep stale agent cleanup as separate step.

fixes.title: _pause_project_workflows missing 'starting' agent status
fixes.description: Shared function filters Agent.status.in_(['working', 'idle']) but /autopilot/stop inline code uses ['working', 'starting', 'idle']. Starting agents may continue launching work after budget exceeded.

fixes.title: Log messages still say 'user-paused' for generalized guards
fixes.description: Guards generalized from == 'user' to is not None but log messages still say 'is user-paused'. Will confuse operators debugging budget enforcement.
fixes.recommended_fix: Change log messages to 'is deliberately paused (paused_by={wf.paused_by})'

fixes.title: Missing tests for _create_corrective_task and _resume_stuck_workflow_tasks guard generalization
fixes.description: Architecture T6 specified tests for all 3 guard locations. Tests only cover _try_auto_resume_paused_workflow. No tests for _create_corrective_task or _resume_stuck_workflow_tasks skipping budget-paused workflows.

fixes.title: Budget guard in _run_one_feature uses separate DB session
fixes.description: Opens new get_db() context for budget check instead of reusing existing session. Could read stale data if cost_total_usd updated between sessions. Low impact due to conservative check behavior.
fixes.recommended_fix: Use existing db session from earlier context block

defers.title: Frontend UI not implemented
defers.description: No cost_limit_usd input in ProjectSettingsModal, no cost display on DesignQueuePanel, no 'Paused: budget limit reached' label. Explicitly deferred in architecture section 3 (File Change Map shows T8 as DEFERRED). Backend enforcement is complete and functional.

defers.title: Budget guard DB session inconsistency
defers.description: pick_next_design reuses existing session, _run_one_feature opens new one. Minor code style inconsistency, not a functional issue.
